# Vendored libraries

Kept in the repository so the dashboard also works without internet access
(exercise networks are often isolated). Licenses are next to the files.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| leaflet.js, leaflet.css | Leaflet | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause |
| milsymbol.js | milsymbol (MIL-STD-2525 / APP-6 symbols) | 3.0.4 | MIT |
| mgrs.min.js | mgrs (proj4js) | 2.1.0 | MIT |
| roslib.min.js | roslibjs (rosbridge client) | 1.4.1 | BSD-2-Clause |
| lucide.min.js | Lucide icons | 0.460.0 | ISC |
